prior_threads.reason: Father William added the Barrow Mound and the witch's house to the map and the party set out to check a marked location, but the treasure is still unfound.

The question of what the Clurichen does each night is answered: Naggeneen drinks Quinn's booze (beat_25). He is now a captive in a bag behind Quinn's bar who offered a pot of gold or a secret for release (beat_26, beat_40), so the situation has changed rather than ended.

The lair's location is now known (beat_63), the dragon reportedly can only be killed with Sir Brandon's buried sword (beat_54), and George doubts Eric can pay the bounty (beat_65), which reshapes the hunt.
Not touched this Session; Sir Phidipaldi's promise to return to Lady Hilda still stands.
Shipments still have not come in, and the cause is still unknown.
Gill is now willing to sell Shamus for less than 100 gold, but only after his sons return (beat_2), which changes the terms of the deal.
Dunk found the magical mithril chain shirt and now means to get it (beat_14, beat_47). Ingrid's nightly visits to Warwick's window partly answer why Warwick is growing paranoid (beat_32).
The thief turned out to be the Clurichen rather than Bentley, and Quinn paid the party 33 gold each (beat_28), so nothing remains wanted or owed.

new_threads.name: Squints and the Halfling Corps
new_threads.reason: Trout recruited Squints on set terms (beat_43), including second pick after the first treasure, which keeps the arrangement open. Brother Dirk now reports to Squints (beat_93).

new_threads.name: Ingrid's sleeping potion for Warwick
new_threads.reason: Dunk struck a deal with Ingrid to get Warwick drugged asleep and supplied the faun wine for it, as his stated plan to get the armor (beat_47). The potion is not finished and Dunk is due to meet her again.

new_threads.name: Sir Brandon's sword in the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: Father William says the dragon cannot be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_54), which gives this thread its stated purpose under the dragon hunt. The party is now on its way to the Barrow.

new_threads.name: Vivian, the witch in the woods
new_threads.reason: The witch's house is now marked on the map and the party means to avoid it. Father William and Ingrid give conflicting accounts of her ties to Ingrid, which leaves the question open.

new_threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance and donation for Father William
new_threads.reason: Uriah agreed to give penance at the Barrow Mound and donate 10 gold in return for the map markings (beat_59). Neither has been done yet.

new_threads.name: Fairies coming out of hiding
new_threads.reason: Ingrid's report that once-hidden fairies are encroaching raises a danger that stands apart from every other thread.

new_threads.name: The giant's cottage in the woods
new_threads.reason: The party rescued Brother Dirk from a man-eating giant on the way north and outran him, but the giant is still there.
